footprint.notes: Employees by area and income taxes paid come from the Annual Report 2025 (company-hosted PDF; it is Exhibit 15.1 to, and incorporated by reference in, the 2025 Form 20-F, hence tier 'filing'). The 2025 report reorganised the geographic split to match its commercial regions, so the areas differ from the 2024 edition: EUCAN (Europe and Canada) is 39,004 and includes Denmark (29,613, reported as 'hereof Denmark'), so the EUCAN region overlaps the Denmark row and is not additive with it; Europe-excluding-Denmark was not derived. USA is a single country (9,961). Region China is defined in the report; APAC and Emerging Markets are Novo groupings described by area, with no country list. Total headcount is 69,505 at Dec 31, 2025 (the report's footnote says the 2024 comparatives exclude Catalent; 2025 has no such exclusion). Taxes are split only into Denmark and outside Denmark (income taxes paid, DKK million, total 32,014). Sites are the 2025 20-F Item 4.D table of major production facilities (production area in square metres) plus the headquarters sentence; Bagsværd, Bloomington, Anagni and Brussels also host other activities listed in the table (e.g. CMO-related activities). API production in New Hampshire is mentioned in the 20-F text but not in the table. No U.S. state figures appear in the 20-F or Annual Report 2025.

marketcap.notes: B shares are priced from the primary listing on Nasdaq Copenhagen (NOVO-B.CO, DKK) rather than the NYSE ADR (NVO, 1 ADR = 1 B share). B shares = 4,465,000,000 total A and B shares − 1,074,872,000 A shares − 58,755,131 treasury B shares = 3,331,372,869 at November 20, 2026, from Novo Nordisk's weekly buyback announcement filed on Form 6-K on November 23, 2026 (which states the total and the treasury holding but not the B count) and the 20-F cover's A-share count. Novo has been buying back B shares under a programme of up to DKK 15 billion running from February 4, 2026, so the 20-F count (3,390,128,000 B shares including treasury) is stale.
